arguments.prompt: Create one game sprite as a crisp outlined 2D Cartoon drawing on genuine transparent alpha. Exact pixel-art reference controls silhouette, pose, orientation, visible anatomy and occlusion; diagnostic source palette is not calibrated material color. Do not turn the pose into a generic side-view icon. Preserve all connected parts and the relative lengths/angles shown; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, text or surrounding effects. Keep complete artwork inside canvas with 6% transparent margin, including every fin/claw/leg and any source line. Subject: ONE caught fish hanging nearly VERTICAL, head at TOP and tail at BOTTOM. The rounded upper body faces to screen-RIGHT with ONE clearly visible bulging white eye and black pupil on its right outline. Tiny mouth points upward at the upper-left of the head beside a short light-gray source fishing-line segment. The narrow tail stalk is nearly straight; the broad two-lobed tail fan spreads below it, with the LEFT lower lobe extending farther downward and the right lobe spreading right. Preserve the two small patterned pectoral fins visible beside the body, and their source overlap. Reference 2 is MATERIAL STYLE ONLY: lively green back/body, pale yellow-cream belly, orange/gold striped fins/tail, crisp dark outlines. Do not copy its horizontal pose or huge generic fins. No extra heads, eyes or invented lower appendages. Preserve just the short source line segment, not a new hook or long line.
